All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] (2002) | bbr = haislma01 }} '''Marcus Deshon Haislip''' (born December 22, 1980) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player who played in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) and other top leagues. Haislip attended Marshall County High School in [[Lewisburg, Tennessee]]. He rose to prominence while playing [[college basketball]] with the [[University of Tennessee]] from 1999 to 2002. After college, he played for several seasons in the NBA and the [[EuroLeague]]. He is listed at {{convert|6|ft|10|in|m|abbr=on}} and 230 lbs. (104 kg).{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/draft2002/profiles/marcus_haislip.html |title=Marcus Haislip |work=NBA.com |date=December 22, 1980 |accessdate=June 17, 2011}} ==Professional career== Haislip was selected by the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] as the 13th pick of the [[2002 NBA draft]]. During his rookie year Haislip was inserted into the starting line-up for the final nine games of the [[2002–03 NBA season]]. When the playoffs started he was relegated to the bench. He remained a bench player with the Bucks for his first two seasons until being placed on waivers on November 4, 2004. He was signed by the [[Indiana Pacers]] during the [[2004–05 NBA season|2004–05 season]] in order to fill the team's gap at [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]], due to the 15-game suspension of [[Jermaine O'Neal]]. He started playing for [[Ülkerspor]] in the 2005–06 season. In March 2006, he left the team without authorization and returned to the United States due to "family issues", according to a teammate. He was selected to the BSL (Turkish Basketball Super League) All-Star Game and also participated in the Slam Dunk contest, which he won. He signed with [[Turkish Basketball League]] powerhouse [[Efes Pilsen SK|Efes Pilsen]] in August 2006.[http://217.13.116.51/noticia.jsp?temporada=E05&jornada=27&id=663 Noticia.jsp Efes Pilsen adds Haislip.] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080305014425/http://217.13.116.51/noticia.jsp?temporada=E05&jornada=27&id=663 |date=March 5, 2008 }} Haislip returned to the U.S. with Pilsen in October 2006, when the team played a pair of exhibition games against [[NBA]] teams. Pilsen played the [[Denver Nuggets]] in Denver on October 11, and played the [[Golden State Warriors]] in Oakland on October 13. Haislip scored 13 points and added 9 rebounds against the Warriors.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/news/story?id=2623475 |title=ESPN - Turkish power Efes Pilsen no match for Warriors - NBA |publisher=[[ESPN]] |date=October 13, 2006 |access-date=June 17, 2011}} On July 13, 2007, Haislip signed with the [[Liga ACB|Spanish ACB]] club [[Unicaja Málaga]].{{cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/14438/180/item |title=Unicaja lands Marcus Haislip - On-Court - Welcome to EUROLEAGUE BASKETBALL |publisher=Euroleague.net |date=July 13, 2007 |accessdate=June 17, 2011}} Haislip was signed by the [[San Antonio Spurs]] of the [[NBA]] on July 8, 2009.{{cite news|title=Spurs Sign Marcus Haislip|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/090708_haislip.html|accessdate=November 24, 2014|work=NBA.com|date=July 8, 2009}} He was waived by the Spurs on January 22, 2010, after appearing in ten games for them.{{cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/wiretap/201534/San-Antonio-Waives-Haislip |title=San Antonio Waives Haislip |publisher=Realgm.com |date=January 22, 2010 |accessdate=November 24, 2014}}{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/100122_haislip.html/ |title=Spurs Waive Marcus Haislip |work=Nba.com |date= |accessdate=June 17, 2011}} That tenth game that Haislip played for the Spurs ended up being his final game in the NBA. His final game was played on January 16, 2010, in a 86 - 92 loss to the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] where he recorded 4 points and 3 rebounds. On January 24, 2010, Haislip signed with the [[Greek Basket League]] powerhouse [[Panathinaikos BC|Panathinaikos]].{{cite news|last1=Skountis|first1=Vassilis|title=PANATHINAIKOS: Marcus Haislip to bolster champs|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/65641/marcus-haislip-signs-on-to-bolster-champs|accessdate=January 29, 2015|work=Euroleague.net|date=January 24, 2010}} He was released on April 16, 2010.{{cite news|title=Haislip and PAO part ways|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/greece/80840/haislip-and-pao-part-ways.html|accessdate=November 24, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=April 16, 2010}} In September 2010, he signed with the Spanish powerhouse [[Tau Ceramica|Caja Laboral]].{{cite news|title=Caja Laboral tabs Marcus Haislip|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/75573/caja-laboral-tabs-marcus-haislip|accessdate=January 29, 2015|work=Euroleague.net|date=September 17, 2010}} In December 2010, Caja Laboral opened disciplinary proceedings against Haislip because he left the city without permission from the club. He was suspended without pay.{{cite news|title=Haislip disobeys Caja Laboral, goes to the U.S. (Update)|url=http://www.talkbasket.net/2835-haislip-disobeys-caja-laboral-goes-to-the-u-s.html|accessdate=November 24, 2014|work=talkbasket.net|date=December 28, 2012}} The contract was terminated by mutual consent on January 5, 2011.{{cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/81046/180/caja-laboral-haislip-split-up |title=Caja Laboral, Haislip split up |publisher=Euroleague.net |date= |accessdate=June 17, 2011}} On January 13, 2011, he signed with the [[Guangdong Southern Tigers]] in China.{{cite news|title=Marcus Haislip inks with Guangdong Tigers|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/84938/marcus-haislip-inks-with-guangdong-tigers.html|accessdate=November 24, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=January 13, 2011}} In December 2011, he signed with the [[Foshan Dralions]].{{cite news|title=Foshan And Jiangsu Sign New Imports Marcus Haislip And Marcus Williams|url=http://www.jumpshot.sg/2011/12/03/foshan-and-jiangsu-sign-new-imports-marcus-haislip-and-marcus-williams/|accessdate=November 24, 2014|work=jumpshot.sg|date=December 3, 2011}} In March 2012, he signed a two-month contract with [[Champville SC]], and became the highest paid foreigner in the history of the [[Lebanese Basketball League]].{{cite news|title=Lebanese club Champville sign Marcus Haislip|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/cat/nba/91084/lebanese-club-champville-sign-marcus-haislip.html|accessdate=November 24, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=March 27, 2012}} Together with his teammate Fadi El Khatib, they won the Lebanese championship for their first time. Champville didn't renew his contract the following year. In September 2012, he joined the [[Dongguan Leopards]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]] for the 2012–13 season.{{cite news|title=Marcus Haislip inks in China with DongGuan|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/94982/marcus-haislip-inks-in-china-with-dongguan.html|accessdate=November 24, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=September 1, 2012}} For the next season he stayed in China but moved to [[Jiangsu Dragons]]. On November 24, 2014, Haislip signed a one-month deal with [[Club Africain (basketball)|Club Africain]] of the [[Tunisian Division I Basketball League|Tunisian League]].{{cite news|title=Marcus Haislip signs for one month in Tunisia with Club Africain|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/africa/142393/marcus-haislip-signs-for-one-month-in-tunisia-with-club-africain.html|accessdate=November 24, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=November 24, 2014}} On December 24, 2014, he signed with [[Eskişehir Basket]] of Turkey for the rest of the season.{{cite news|title=Marcus Haislip heading to Eskisehir Basket|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/146172/marcus-haislip-heading-to-eskisehir-basket.html|accessdate=December 25, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=December 24, 2014}} In December 2015, he signed with [[Türk Telekom B.K.|Türk Telekom]] for the rest of the 2015–16 season.{{cite news|title=Marcus Haislip signs with Turk Telekom Ankara|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/184833/marcus-haislip-signs-with-turk-telekom-ankara.html|accessdate=December 14, 2015|work=Sportando.com|date=December 14, 2015}} In May 2016, he signed in China with the Guizhou White Tigers for the 2016 [[National Basketball League (China)|NBL]] season. In August 2016, Haislip signed with Turkish club [[Gaziantep Basketbol]].[http://www.asia-basket.com/China/news/459907/Marcus-Haislip-(ex-Guizhou)-agreed-terms-with-Gaziantep Marcus Haislip (ex
